derivation_rules.derivation_rule: Aggregator relation sections (certified_cross_pack_relations, candidate_cross_pack_relations, ontology_review_cross_pack_relations, identity_review_cross_pack_relations) must be exact mathematical projections of the corresponding arrays in relation_gap_map.
derivation_rules.invariant: Zero instances of deepens, bridges, buffers, or forms_part_of in certified relations. Parity = 100%.

derivation_rules.derivation_rule: Every evidence_unit.source_id must exist in the authoritative source registry, and evidence_unit.source_hash must equal the registered source_file_sha256.
Every evidence_unit.source_locator must resolve to an ACTIVE locator in the consolidated locator registry or an explicit canonical alias in locator errata.
derivation_rules.invariant: Broken evidence locators = 0; Unknown locators = 0. Referential integrity = 100%.

derivation_rules.derivation_rule: Each cell in the completeness matrix is derived deterministically from the field binding record for (entity_id, field_name). Broad entity-level evidence bundles are strictly prohibited from populating fields without field-specific support.
derivation_rules.invariant: Completeness metrics in matrix equal exact aggregate counts in field bindings. Mentions do not equal evidence.

derivation_rules.derivation_rule: Every SOURCE_GROUNDED topographic interface clause must bind to an active evidence unit, and its locator must equal the evidence unit locator.
derivation_rules.invariant: No SOURCE_GROUNDED interface without verified evidence; locator parity = 100%.

derivation_rules.derivation_rule: 3D viewer mapping metrics must derive strictly from verified runtime database rows, strictly decoupled from anatomical entity readiness.
derivation_rules.invariant: Fabricated 3D IDs = 0; Viewer mapped count = 0; Row parity = 100%.
